scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 mixed with substantial friction; 7 good with meaningful rough edges; 10 exceptional observed mobile experience. Subjective holistic assessment of only these emulated attempts, not an outcome-based grade or physical-device certification.

reasons.overall_mobile: Playable to completion with useful touch assists and clear goals; ammunition recovery and offscreen pressure imposed substantial friction. Winning once and losing once do not determine the grade.
reasons.controls: Tap-to-aim, large FIRE target and two-contact ROUTE plus FIRE worked. Manual stick movement worked but led into walls; SWAP gave no visible change. Fine aim dragging, AIM and dash/vault were not meaningfully assessed.
reasons.gameplay: Recovery-to-coils-to-return provided visible progression; numbered coil destruction was satisfying progress feedback. Long firing spent ammo through armor windows; stopping defense on route resulted in rapid loss. Exact damage balance cannot be judged from paused intervals.
reasons.presentation: Coherent cyan/amber industrial storm setting, distinct copper coils and polished title/end cards. Dark angular scenery and close walls sometimes obscured useful world context. Audio unassessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, map pause, ROUTE, TURN warnings, automatic reload behavior and explicit fresh restart helped. Supply advice lacked a clear location, secondary controls were behind TOOLS, and return/upload resolved inside a route interval without detailed inspection.
reasons.readability: Objective, health/ammo, recovery progress and coil percentages readable at 390x844. Dense upper/lower HUD leaves a narrow combat view; result detail text is small but readable in captures.
